summary: Iter-83 — Sounds ⇄ For You unification (canonical sound post pipeline) + collapsible Fire Power profile cards. BACKEND: 14/15 pytest cases pass (test_sound_unification.py). Verified: (1) shared /api/sounds/classifications returns music/podcasts/fx/other with stable ids; (2) POST /api/sounds/upload multipart with rights_confirmed=true creates track AND canonical post in one call, response.track.post.id present, and the post appears in GET /api/posts?media_type=sound and in /api/sounds/feed (t.post embed); (3) upload with defer_post=true creates track WITHOUT canonical post, then POST /api/posts by owner with sound_track_id marks the new post as the canonical (is_canonical_sound=true, source_composer='foryou') and the track then appears on /api/sounds/feed with t.post pointing at the share; (4) fire sync — 3x fire on canonical sound post reports the SAME total (=3) in both GET /api/sounds/feed (t.post.fire_total) and GET /api/posts?media_type=sound; (5) 5x boosted fire recipient side = full 5 on post fire_total (recipient full-value accounting preserved); (6) sort=fire&window=all sounds feed is desc-ordered by lifetime fire_total; (7) For You dedupe — each sound_track_id/track_id appears at most ONCE across /api/posts?media_type=sound; (8) PATCH track title/visibility SYNCS onto canonical post (sound_title updated, audience.visibility='friends'); (9) DELETE canonical post correctly removes the track; (10) migration endpoints founder-only (support+member get 403), dry-run non-destructive report OK, execute requires phrase, re-execute idempotent (skipped_existing>=1 confirms migration already ran in preview); (11) PATCH /api/sounds/admin/classifications/music founder-only (support 403), rename Music→Musica reflected in sounds feed classification_name (music tracks pick up new display name while classification_id stays 'music'), REVERTED back to 'Music' after test; (12) comments on canonical post via POST /api/posts/{pid}/comment (field 'text', not 'content') persist and return via GET /api/posts/{pid}/comments; (13) friends-only track hidden from non-friend viewer on /api/sounds/feed. FRONTEND: /sounds page shows 5 FireButtons ([data-testid^='sounds-fire-'][data-testid$='-btn']) with matching boost-open arrows, ZERO Heart like buttons; fire click succeeded (integration OK). /profile (own): fire-wallet-header + fire-wallet-toggle testids present, fire-wallet-pool-section NOT in DOM by default (collapsed), click expands showing DAILY FIRE POOL/PERMANENT FIRE VAULT/etc; RELOAD returns to collapsed (not persisted — correct). /profile/stealth (public): public-fire-stats-header present, collapsed by default (Lifetime text hidden), click expands showing Lifetime/Received/Given/Collected(Private)/Vault(Private)/Supporters/Weekly Fire/Most-fired-post — matches Rising Star Progress + Progression Badges card styling. TWO BUGS FOUND (see below).

critical.issue: Deleting a track does NOT remove the linked canonical post — leaves an orphan canonical post + comments in /api/posts?media_type=sound. Requirement explicitly says 'DELETE track removes the canonical post + comments'. RCA: routers/sounds.py delete_track() (L418-437) never calls services.sound_posts.delete_canonical_for_track(track_id). Only the reverse direction (posts.delete_post) cleans up the track. FIX: add `from services import sound_posts as sp; await sp.delete_canonical_for_track(track_id)` inside delete_track before the file-cleanup try block.

ui_bugs.issue: The Charts <Dropdown> options are `const CHARTS = ["Top 100", "Trending", "New Releases", "Up & Coming", "Editor's Picks"]` (L34) — the '🔥 Top Fire' entry is MISSING from this array, so users can never select it, and the Window dropdown (sort=fire) never renders even though the code at L178-180 + L319 fully supports it. The backend contract works (sort=fire&window=... orders correctly, tested). Requirement: '/sounds Charts dropdown has 🔥 Top Fire option'. FIX: add "🔥 Top Fire" to the CHARTS array (recommend as the first entry so it's the visual anchor). Verified in DOM: opening the Charts dropdown lists exactly the 5 legacy options.

action_items: BACKEND FIX (HIGH): In /app/backend/routers/sounds.py `delete_track()` (~L418), call `await sp.delete_canonical_for_track(track_id)` (import `from services import sound_posts as sp`) BEFORE the file-cleanup block so the canonical post + comments are removed when the owner (or founder) deletes the track. This closes the two-way symmetry expected by the requirement.

FRONTEND FIX (HIGH): In /app/frontend/src/pages/Sounds.jsx L34, change `const CHARTS = ["Top 100", ...]` to `const CHARTS = ["🔥 Top Fire", "Top 100", "Trending", "New Releases", "Up & Coming", "Editor's Picks"]` so users can select the fire-ranked chart. The rest of the flow (fire window dropdown via `chart === '🔥 Top Fire'` guard at L319 and the API params merge at L178-180) is already wired correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: services/sound_posts.py — clean single-source-of-truth service: `create_canonical_post` is idempotent per track (checks `canonical_post_for_track` first), `_post_doc_for_track` mirrors ALL required fields (media_type='sound', content_type='sound', is_canonical_sound=True, sound_track_id, sound_classification_id, audience from track visibility), and hooks progression + moderation + hashtags on the canonical post so Fire Power/comments/hashtags 'just work' without router-specific glue.

routers/posts.py L137-156 (create_post canonical marking) is correct: only marks is_canonical_sound=True when the poster is the track owner AND no canonical exists yet (guards against race + non-owner reshare stealing canonicality). Sets source_composer='foryou' as required. Also mirrors audience onto the track so /sounds respects the same visibility (mirror direction: post→track). Good.

routers/posts.py L483-583 (For You media_type=sound merge) does the right dedupe: uses a GLOBAL canonical-check (db.posts.distinct sound_track_id where is_canonical_sound=True) BEFORE merging pseudo track posts, so a track that has a canonical post is represented once via the canonical row and never re-added as a pseudo `is_sound_track` post. Test confirmed zero duplicates across 200 items.

routers/sounds.py delete_track() (L418-437) MISSING canonical post cleanup — see backend_issues.critical. Contrast with routers/posts.py delete_post (L257-269) which does the reverse cleanup correctly.

frontend Sounds.jsx CHARTS array (L34) missing '🔥 Top Fire' — see frontend_issues.ui_bugs. The rest of the fire-ranked flow (state fireWindow, params merge, window dropdown render, testid sounds-fire-window) is complete and works when the chart is manually forced via DevTools.

components/fire/FireWalletCard.jsx + PublicFireStats.jsx use `useAccordionState(key, defaultOpen=false)` and CollapsibleHeader — behavior matches spec: always collapsed on open, not persisted across reloads (verified by explicit reload test), single-click toggle, matches Creator Progress / Progression Badges header animation. Excellent parity.

rca of the issue: BUG 1 (DELETE track leaves canonical post): routers/sounds.py `delete_track` was implemented before the sound-post unification and never updated to remove the canonical post. Fix is a single line: `from services import sound_posts as sp; await sp.delete_canonical_for_track(track_id)` inside the delete_track function (after the auth check, before the file cleanup try block). Reproduction: upload a track via /api/sounds/upload (defer_post=false) → note track.post.id → DELETE /api/sounds/{tid} → GET /api/posts?media_type=sound → the post is still there. BUG 2 (Charts missing 🔥 Top Fire): frontend/src/pages/Sounds.jsx L34 CHARTS array literal omits the entry. The chart-state code at L178-180 and the fireWindow dropdown at L319 both already support the chart string '🔥 Top Fire', so adding the string to the CHARTS array is a one-line fix. Reproduction: /sounds → click Charts dropdown → observe only Top 100/Trending/New Releases/Up & Coming/Editor's Picks — no fire option.
